variants.title: DLTS of the EL2 level in GaAs
variants.sample: Schottky diode on n-GaAs with the EL2 deep donor (SIMULATED)
variants.method: double-boxcar DLTS at four rate windows
variants.unknown: trap activation energy, capture cross-section, trap density
variants.note: EL2 is the native mid-gap donor of GaAs, near Ec - 0.82 eV; it emits at room temperature and above, so the peaks lie near 350-400 K. gamma for GaAs electrons 2.3e20 cm^-2 s^-1 K^-2 and the EL2 energy are quoted from memory - verify.

source.title: G. M. Martin, A. Mitonneau and A. Mircea, Electron. Lett. 13, 191 (1977): EL2
